column2:
machinery(n.)機器(總稱)、機構、體制
machine(n.)機器
heavy machinery 重型機械
farm machinery 農業機械
The factory bought new machinery last year.
(那家工廠去年購買了新機器。)
Workers must be careful when using heavy machinery.
(工人使用重型機械時必須小心。)

magnetic(adj.)磁性的、有吸引力的
magnet(n.)磁鐵
magnetism(n.)磁性、魅力
magnetic field 磁場
magnetic personality 有魅力的個性
The earth has a strong magnetic field.
(地球有強大的磁場。)
She has a magnetic personality that attracts friends.
(她很有個人魅力，很容易吸引朋友。)

magnificent(adj.)壯麗的、宏偉的、極好的
magnificence(n.)壯麗
magnificent view 壯麗的景色
magnificent building 宏偉的建築
We enjoyed a magnificent view from the mountaintop.
(我們在山頂欣賞到壯麗的景色。)
The palace is a magnificent building.
(那座宮殿是一棟宏偉的建築。)

makeup(n.)化妝品、化妝、組成
make up(v.)化妝、組成、編造
wear makeup 化妝
makeup exam 補考
She doesn't wear makeup to school.
(她上學不化妝。)
Students who were sick can take a makeup exam.
(生病的學生可以參加補考。)

manual(n./adj.)手冊、手工的、體力的
manually(adv.)手動地
user manual 使用手冊
manual labor 體力勞動
Read the user manual before using the machine.
(使用機器前先閱讀使用手冊。)
Farming used to require a lot of manual labor.
(以前農耕需要大量的體力勞動。)

manufacture(n./v.)製造、製造業
manufacturer(n.)製造商
manufacturing(n.)製造業
manufacture cars 製造汽車
be manufactured in 在⋯製造
This company manufactures bicycles for export.
(這家公司製造外銷用的腳踏車。)
Most of these toys are manufactured in Asia.
(這些玩具大多在亞洲製造。)

manufacturer(n.)製造商、廠商
manufacture(v.)製造
car manufacturer 汽車製造商
leading manufacturer 主要製造商
Taiwan has some of the world's leading chip manufacturers.
(台灣擁有一些世界領先的晶片製造商。)
Contact the manufacturer if the product is broken.
(如果產品壞了，請聯絡製造商。)

marathon(n.)馬拉松
(無詞性變化)
run a marathon 跑馬拉松
marathon runner 馬拉松跑者
My uncle ran the Taipei Marathon last December.
(我叔叔去年十二月跑了台北馬拉松。)
Running a marathon requires months of training.
(跑馬拉松需要好幾個月的訓練。)

margin(n.)頁邊空白、差距、利潤
marginal(adj.)邊緣的、少量的
by a narrow margin 以些微差距
in the margin 在頁邊空白處
The teacher wrote comments in the margin.
(老師在頁邊空白處寫了評語。)
Our team won by a narrow margin.
(我們隊以些微差距獲勝。)

maturity(n.)成熟
mature(adj./v.)成熟的、使成熟
show maturity 表現成熟
reach maturity 達到成熟
He showed great maturity in handling the problem.
(他處理問題時表現得非常成熟。)
These trees reach maturity in about ten years.
(這些樹大約十年後成熟。)

maximum(adj./n.)最大的、最大量
maximize(v.)使最大化
maximum speed 最高速度
to the maximum 到最大程度
The maximum speed on this road is 50 km per hour.
(這條路的最高速限是每小時五十公里。)
This elevator holds a maximum of ten people.
(這部電梯最多可載十人。)

measurable(adj.)可測量的、顯著的
measure(v.)測量
measurement(n.)測量、尺寸
measurable goal 可衡量的目標
measurable progress 顯著的進步
Set a clear and measurable goal for your study plan.
(為你的讀書計畫設定一個明確且可衡量的目標。)
The new teaching method led to measurable improvement.
(新的教學方法帶來了顯著的進步。)

measure(n.)措施(常用複數 measures)、尺度、量
measure(v.)測量
measurement(n.)測量、尺寸
take measures 採取措施
safety measures 安全措施
The government took measures to prevent the flu.
(政府採取措施預防流感。)
Schools have strict safety measures during typhoons.
(颱風期間學校有嚴格的安全措施。)

mechanic(n.)技工、機械工
mechanical(adj.)機械的
mechanics(n.)力學、機械學
car mechanic 汽車修理工
skilled mechanic 熟練的技工
The mechanic fixed my scooter in an hour.
(技師在一小時內修好了我的機車。)
He works as a car mechanic in a small garage.
(他在一家小修車廠當汽車修理工。)

mechanical(adj.)機械的、機械式的
mechanic(n.)技工
mechanically(adv.)機械地
mechanical problem 機械故障
mechanical engineering 機械工程
The flight was delayed due to a mechanical problem.
(班機因機械故障而延誤。)
He answered the questions in a mechanical way.
(他機械式地回答問題。)

memorable(adj.)難忘的、值得紀念的
memory(n.)記憶
memorize(v.)記住
memorable experience 難忘的經驗
memorable moment 難忘的時刻
The graduation trip was a memorable experience.
(畢業旅行是一次難忘的經驗。)
It was one of the most memorable moments of my life.
(那是我人生中最難忘的時刻之一。)

memorial(adj./n.)紀念的、紀念物、紀念館
memory(n.)記憶
memorial service 追悼會
war memorial 戰爭紀念碑
Many tourists visit the Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall.
(許多觀光客參觀中正紀念堂。)
A memorial service was held for the victims.
(為罹難者舉行了追悼會。)

memorize(v.)記住、背誦
memory(n.)記憶
memorization(n.)記憶、背誦
memorize vocabulary 背單字
memorize a poem 背一首詩
I memorize ten new words every day.
(我每天背十個新單字。)
She memorized the whole poem for the contest.
(她為了比賽背下了整首詩。)

merchant(n.)商人
merchandise(n.)商品
merchant ship 商船
wealthy merchant 富商
The merchant sold silk and tea to foreign traders.
(那位商人把絲綢和茶葉賣給外國貿易商。)
Many merchants traveled along the Silk Road.
(許多商人沿著絲路旅行。)

mercy(n.)仁慈、憐憫、寬恕
merciful(adj.)仁慈的
merciless(adj.)無情的
at the mercy of 任由⋯擺布
show mercy 表現仁慈
The small boat was at the mercy of the storm.
(那艘小船任由暴風雨擺布。)
The king showed mercy and set the prisoner free.
(國王大發慈悲，釋放了那名囚犯。)

mere(adj.)僅僅的、只不過的
merely(adv.)僅僅、只不過
a mere child 只是個孩子
the mere thought of 一想到⋯
He was a mere child when he left home.
(他離家時只不過是個孩子。)
The mere thought of the exam makes me nervous.
(一想到考試就讓我緊張。)

merit(n.)優點、價值、功績
(無詞性變化)
on merit 憑實力
merits and demerits 優缺點
Each plan has its own merits.
(每個計畫都有各自的優點。)
Students are chosen on merit, not on family background.
(學生是憑實力而非家庭背景被選上的。)

messenger(n.)送信人、使者
message(n.)訊息
send a messenger 派使者
messenger bag 郵差包
The king sent a messenger with the news.
(國王派使者傳達這個消息。)
Don't blame the messenger for bad news.
(別因為壞消息而怪罪傳話的人。)

messy(adj.)凌亂的、髒亂的、棘手的
mess(n.)凌亂、困境
messy room 凌亂的房間
messy hair 亂髮
My brother's room is always messy.
(我弟弟的房間總是很亂。)
Eating spaghetti can be messy for kids.
(對小孩來說吃義大利麵常會弄得一團糟。)

microscope(n.)顯微鏡
microscopic(adj.)極小的、顯微鏡的
under a microscope 在顯微鏡下
electron microscope 電子顯微鏡
We looked at the cells under a microscope.
(我們在顯微鏡下觀察細胞。)
The microscope was a great help to biologists.
(顯微鏡對生物學家幫助很大。)

mild(adj.)溫和的、溫暖的、輕微的
mildly(adv.)溫和地、稍微
mild weather 溫和的天氣
mild symptoms 輕微的症狀
Taiwan has mild winters.
(台灣的冬天很溫和。)
He only had a mild cold and soon got better.
(他只是輕微感冒，很快就好了。)

mill(n./v.)磨坊、工廠、磨碎
miller(n.)磨坊主人
paper mill 造紙廠
windmill 風車
The old mill by the river is now a museum.
(河邊那座舊磨坊現在是博物館。)
Farmers took their wheat to the mill.
(農夫們把小麥送到磨坊。)

millionaire(n.)百萬富翁
million(n.)百萬
become a millionaire 成為百萬富翁
self-made millionaire 白手起家的富翁
He became a millionaire before he was thirty.
(他在三十歲前就成了百萬富翁。)
Even millionaires can't buy happiness.
(就算是百萬富翁也買不到快樂。)

miner(n.)礦工
mine(n.)礦坑
coal miner 煤礦工
gold miner 淘金者
Coal miners once worked hard in Jiufen and Ruifang.
(以前煤礦工人在九份和瑞芳辛苦工作。)
The trapped miners were rescued after three days.
(受困的礦工在三天後獲救。)

mineral(n.)礦物、礦物質
(無詞性變化)
mineral water 礦泉水
vitamins and minerals 維生素和礦物質
Would you like a bottle of mineral water?
(你要一瓶礦泉水嗎？)
Vegetables are rich in vitamins and minerals.
(蔬菜富含維生素和礦物質。)

minimum(adj./n.)最小的、最低限度
minimize(v.)使減到最少
minimal(adj.)極少的
minimum wage 最低工資
at a minimum 至少
The minimum wage in Taiwan goes up almost every year.
(台灣的基本工資幾乎每年都調漲。)
You need a minimum of 60 points to pass.
(你至少需要六十分才能及格。)

minister(n.)部長、牧師
ministry(n.)(政府的)部
prime minister 首相、總理
Minister of Education 教育部長
The Minister of Education visited our school.
(教育部長參訪了我們學校。)
The prime minister gave a speech on TV.
(首相在電視上發表演說。)

ministry(n.)(政府的)部、牧師職務
minister(n.)部長、牧師
Ministry of Education 教育部
Ministry of Health 衛生部
The Ministry of Education announced a new policy.
(教育部宣布了一項新政策。)
He works for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
(他在外交部工作。)

mischief(n.)惡作劇、淘氣、損害
mischievous(adj.)淘氣的、惡作劇的
get into mischief 調皮搗蛋
full of mischief 十分淘氣
The kids got into mischief while their parents were out.
(爸媽出門時孩子們調皮搗蛋。)
His eyes were full of mischief.
(他的眼神充滿了淘氣。)

miserable(adj.)悲慘的、痛苦的、糟糕的
misery(n.)痛苦、不幸
feel miserable 感到難受
miserable weather 糟糕的天氣
I felt miserable when I had a high fever.
(我發高燒時覺得非常難受。)
The refugees lived in miserable conditions.
(難民們生活在悲慘的環境中。)

misfortune(n.)不幸、厄運
fortune(n.)運氣、財富
suffer misfortune 遭遇不幸
have the misfortune to 不幸⋯
She had the misfortune to lose her job.
(她不幸失去了工作。)
Don't laugh at other people's misfortune.
(不要嘲笑別人的不幸。)

mislead(v.)誤導、欺騙
misleading(adj.)誤導的
mislead the public 誤導大眾
misleading information 誤導性的資訊
The ad misled customers about the price.
(那則廣告在價格上誤導了消費者。)
Be careful of misleading information online.
(小心網路上的誤導性資訊。)

misunderstand(v.)誤解、誤會
misunderstanding(n.)誤會
completely misunderstand 完全誤解
clear up a misunderstanding 澄清誤會
Please don't misunderstand me; I was only joking.
(請別誤會我，我只是在開玩笑。)
We talked and cleared up the misunderstanding.
(我們談過之後澄清了誤會。)

moderate(adj.)中等的、適度的、溫和的
moderately(adv.)適度地
moderation(n.)適度
moderate exercise 適度的運動
in moderation 適量地
Doctors suggest thirty minutes of moderate exercise a day.
(醫生建議每天做三十分鐘適度的運動。)
Eating sweets in moderation is fine.
(適量吃甜食是沒關係的。)

modest(adj.)謙虛的、適度的、樸素的
modesty(n.)謙虛
modestly(adv.)謙虛地
modest about 對⋯很謙虛
a modest income 不多的收入
He is very modest about his success.
(他對自己的成功非常謙虛。)
They live in a modest house in the countryside.
(他們住在鄉下一間樸素的房子裡。)

modesty(n.)謙虛、樸素
modest(adj.)謙虛的
with modesty 謙虛地
false modesty 假謙虛
She accepted the award with modesty.
(她謙虛地接受了這個獎項。)
Modesty is considered a virtue in many cultures.
(在許多文化中，謙虛被視為一種美德。)

monitor(n./v.)螢幕、班長、監視器、監控
(無詞性變化)
class monitor 班長
monitor progress 監控進度
Our class monitor helps the teacher every day.
(我們的班長每天都幫老師的忙。)
Doctors closely monitored his condition.
(醫生密切監控他的病情。)

monument(n.)紀念碑、紀念建築、古蹟
monumental(adj.)紀念性的、巨大的
historic monument 歷史古蹟
build a monument 建紀念碑
A monument was built to honor the soldiers.
(人們建了一座紀念碑來紀念那些士兵。)
The castle is a historic monument.
(這座城堡是一處歷史古蹟。)

moreover(adv.)此外、而且
(無詞性變化)
and moreover 而且
Moreover, ... 此外，⋯
The hotel is cheap. Moreover, it's close to the station.
(這間旅館很便宜，而且離車站很近。)
Exercise keeps you fit. Moreover, it improves your mood.
(運動讓你保持健康，此外還能改善心情。)

motivate(v.)激勵、促使
motivation(n.)動機
motivated(adj.)積極的、有動機的
motivate students 激勵學生
be motivated to 有動力去⋯
Good teachers know how to motivate students.
(好老師知道如何激勵學生。)
She was motivated to study harder after the test.
(考試後她更有動力用功讀書。)

motivation(n.)動機、幹勁
motivate(v.)激勵
motive(n.)動機
lack of motivation 缺乏動機
strong motivation 強烈的動機
Lack of motivation is a common problem for students.
(缺乏動機是學生常見的問題。)
His motivation for learning Japanese is his love of anime.
(他學日文的動機是因為熱愛動漫。)

mountainous(adj.)多山的、巨大的
mountain(n.)山
mountainous area 山區
mountainous country 多山的國家
Much of Taiwan is mountainous.
(台灣大部分地區多山。)
The village is in a remote mountainous area.
(那個村莊位於偏遠的山區。)

muddy(adj.)泥濘的、沾滿泥的
mud(n.)泥巴
muddy road 泥濘的道路
muddy shoes 沾滿泥的鞋子
Take off your muddy shoes before coming in.
(進來前先脫掉你沾滿泥巴的鞋子。)
The road became muddy after the heavy rain.
(大雨過後道路變得泥濘。)

mule(n.)騾子、頑固的人
(無詞性變化)
as stubborn as a mule 非常固執
ride a mule 騎騾子
The farmer used a mule to carry the goods.
(農夫用騾子載運貨物。)
My brother is as stubborn as a mule.
(我哥哥固執得要命。)

multiple(adj.)多重的、多樣的
multiply(v.)乘、增加
multiple-choice question 選擇題
multiple times 多次
The test has 30 multiple-choice questions.
(這份考卷有三十題選擇題。)
She has called him multiple times, but he didn't answer.
(她打了好幾次電話給他，但他都沒接。)

murderer(n.)殺人兇手
murder(n./v.)謀殺
cold-blooded murderer 冷血殺手
catch the murderer 抓到兇手
The police finally caught the murderer.
(警方終於抓到了殺人兇手。)
In the novel, the murderer turns out to be the butler.
(在小說中，兇手原來是管家。)

murmur(n./v.)低語、潺潺聲、喃喃地說
(無詞性變化)
murmur of the stream 溪水潺潺聲
murmur to oneself 喃喃自語
She murmured something I couldn't hear.
(她低聲說了些我聽不見的話。)
We fell asleep to the murmur of the stream.
(我們在溪水的潺潺聲中睡著了。)

mutual(adj.)相互的、共同的
mutually(adv.)相互地
mutual respect 互相尊重
mutual friend 共同的朋友
Good friendship is based on mutual respect.
(良好的友誼建立在互相尊重之上。)
We met through a mutual friend.
(我們是透過一位共同的朋友認識的。)

mysterious(adj.)神祕的、難以理解的
mystery(n.)謎、神祕的事物
mysteriously(adv.)神祕地
mysterious stranger 神祕的陌生人
mysterious disappearance 離奇失蹤
A mysterious letter arrived without a name.
(一封沒有署名的神祕信件寄來了。)
The ship disappeared under mysterious circumstances.
(那艘船在離奇的情況下失蹤了。)

namely(adv.)即、也就是
(無詞性變化)
namely that 也就是說
two reasons, namely... 兩個原因，即⋯
Only one student passed, namely Amy.
(只有一個學生及格，那就是艾咪。)
We need two things, namely time and money.
(我們需要兩樣東西，也就是時間和金錢。)

nationality(n.)國籍
nation(n.)國家
national(adj.)國家的
dual nationality 雙重國籍
of different nationalities 不同國籍的
What is your nationality?
(你的國籍是什麼？)
Students of many nationalities study at this school.
(許多不同國籍的學生在這所學校就讀。)

needy(adj.)貧窮的、窮困的
need(n./v.)需要
needy families 貧困家庭
the needy 窮人
The charity gives food to needy families.
(那個慈善團體提供食物給貧困家庭。)
We should help the needy in our community.
(我們應該幫助社區中的窮人。)

neglect(n./v.)忽視、疏忽
negligence(n.)疏忽、過失
neglected(adj.)被忽視的
neglect one's duty 怠忽職守
child neglect 兒童疏於照顧
Don't neglect your health because of work.
(不要因為工作而忽略你的健康。)
The garden was in a state of neglect.
(花園處於荒廢狀態。)

negotiate(v.)談判、協商
negotiation(n.)談判
negotiator(n.)談判者
negotiate with 與⋯談判
negotiate a price 議價
The two countries agreed to negotiate a peace deal.
(兩國同意就和平協議進行談判。)
You can negotiate the price at the night market.
(你可以在夜市討價還價。)

nevertheless(adv.)然而、不過、儘管如此
(無詞性變化)
but nevertheless 但儘管如此
Nevertheless, ... 然而，⋯
It was raining hard; nevertheless, the game went on.
(雨下得很大，然而比賽仍繼續進行。)
The task was difficult. Nevertheless, we finished it.
(這任務很困難，儘管如此我們還是完成了。)

nightmare(n.)惡夢、可怕的經歷
(無詞性變化)
have a nightmare 做惡夢
a living nightmare 活生生的惡夢
I had a nightmare about being chased by a tiger.
(我夢到被老虎追的惡夢。)
Driving in the heavy traffic was a nightmare.
(在擁擠的車流中開車簡直是場惡夢。)

noble(adj./n.)高尚的、貴族的、貴族
nobility(n.)貴族、高尚
noble cause 崇高的目標
noble family 貴族家庭
Helping the poor is a noble cause.
(幫助窮人是一項崇高的事業。)
She was born into a noble family.
(她出身於貴族家庭。)
